title: #06 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR NOW OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Trials for Navigator will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Trial Tasks for Trial EXP, and increasing the level of Path of Trials.
REWARDS: MARTHE Collection - The Wind Rider for Bubble, Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Furniture Parts, etc.
Please stay tuned for more information!
